notes: Self-contained: every case reviews the committed fixture evals/fixtures/sample-ui-lib, a tiny publishable React component library with a REVIEW.md overlay and nothing installed, so no render can run. The fixture plants five defects (A1 forced colors, R1 spread order, A2 reduced-motion hover cue, A3 an 18 px unlabeled target, P1 a variant-to-class map), one R1 defect in src/legacy/ that src/legacy/REVIEW.md switches off, and three traps that must not be reported (X1 a boolean prop mirroring aria-invalid, X7 a dependency-less useLayoutEffect, X4 a 24 px switch a 44 px rule would flag). A finding counts when one line names the file with a line number and the rule id, as the finding shape requires.

evals.name: full-review
evals.prompt: I'm about to publish skills/front-review/evals/fixtures/sample-ui-lib as an npm package. Can you review the components first? Accessibility, React code, bundle size, the lot.
evals.expected_output: A fix list in the report template: the five planted defects with file:line and rule id, nothing from src/legacy/OldField.tsx, and VERDICT: CHANGES on the last line.
assertions: A1 is reported on src/Checkbox.module.css with a line number
R1 is reported on src/Input.tsx with a line number
A2 is reported on src/Button.module.css with a line number
A3 is reported on src/IconButton (tsx or module.css) with a line number
P1 is reported on src/Button.tsx with a line number
The R1 defect switched off by src/legacy/REVIEW.md is not reported (no OldField.tsx:line citation)
The last non-empty line is VERDICT: CHANGES

evals.name: a11y-pass
evals.prompt: Do an accessibility pass on skills/front-review/evals/fixtures/sample-ui-lib: forced colors, reduced motion, target sizes, all of it.
evals.expected_output: The three accessibility defects with file:line and rule id, no finding on the 24 px Switch, no 44 px threshold, and a Not checked line naming the render probes that could not run.
assertions: A1 is reported on src/Checkbox.module.css with a line number
A2 is reported on src/Button.module.css with a line number
A3 is reported on src/IconButton (tsx or module.css) with a line number
No finding cites src/Switch (the 24 px target meets the floor)
No 44 px threshold is applied
A Not checked line lists what could not be verified

evals.name: fr-pr-style
evals.prompt: Fais-moi une revue du code front dans skills/front-review/evals/fixtures/sample-ui-lib, comme pour une PR : qu'est-ce qui bloque ?
evals.expected_output: The report in French with the fr vocabulary (Bloquant, Non vérifié), the R1 finding on Input.tsx, none of the X1/X7 traps, nothing from src/legacy/OldField.tsx, and VERDICT: CHANGES.
assertions: The report uses the French section names (a Bloquant heading)
A Non vérifié line lists what could not be verified
R1 is reported on src/Input.tsx with a line number
The boolean invalid prop is not reported (no R5, no boolean-prop finding)
The dependency-less useLayoutEffect is not reported (no R7, no dependency array or memoization advice)
The R1 defect switched off by src/legacy/REVIEW.md is not reported (no OldField.tsx:line citation)
The last non-empty line is VERDICT: CHANGES
